**Day and time**: Friday, November 13, from 8 to 10 am

**Mentors:** Riva Quiroga, Yanina Bellini Saibene, Jeroen Ooms

**About:**

Want to contribute to the R ecosystem but don't know where to start?

In this two-hour hackathon we will work on real contributions to base R and rOpenSci projects.

You can join whether you want to take your first steps or you've already contributed: there will be experienced people to support you, answer your questions, and help you turn an idea, an issue, or an improvement into a concrete contribution.

Bring your curiosity and your willingness to contribute!
